asset.Name: Better Aircraft
asset.Description:
Makes the Xenonaut interceptors and dropships sturdier, faster on the Geoscape and longer-ranged. Air combat handling and weapons stay as in the base game.

ALL XENONAUT AIRCRAFT
- Hull: +50% (interceptors 150 / 225 / 300, was 100 / 150 / 200; dropships 150 / 1,500, was 100 / 1,000)
- Geoscape speed: +25% (interceptors 180 / 300 / 400, was 144 / 240 / 320; upgraded Angel and Phantom engines 275 / 375, was 220 / 300)
- Fuel consumption: -25% (a third more range)
- Hull repair speed: x2

COMPATIBILITY
- Replaces the Xenonaut aircraft profiles, the Xenonaut aircraft masters and the two upgraded engines: do not use together with any mod that edits the same files.
- UFOs are not affected.
- Works with Aircraft Weapons +25%, Better Base and Finance x3.
